subject: [hw] DONE V40 rev 2 (387 checks, 1161/1161; no interface change)
body:
Rev 2 of V40, tests only plus two documentation lines; no interface or semantic change. Three more behaviours are now covered: every VENC id shares one AP->daemon queue (IPI_VENC_COMMON then IPI_VENC_H264 overwrite, as user_obj[2] does), GET_OBJECT with a garbage id lands in the VENC slot (the kernel does not range-check the id), and the ACK counter only moves for id > IPI_VCU_INIT with handler return 0.

Last line of bash gpu/hwcodec/vcu/test_v40/run_tests.sh:
    N2TEST V40 PASS 1161/1161
(three builds of 387 checks: ASan+UBSan -O1, plain -O2, TSan -O1; about 5 s; /tmp/n2hw-V40 only.)
    bash gpu/hwcodec/vcu/test_v40/compile_ios.sh -> N2TEST V40-IOS PASS 1/1 (compile only)

Documentation added to vcu/STATUS.md: mmap falls through to the window/DMEM rules when the flagged PA lookup fails (the kernel returns -EINVAL), and CMD_MEM_MV/CMD_POLL_ADDR accept any address inside an allocated DMA buffer while vcu_check_gce_pa_base() only accepts the first page of a PA allocation (the vendor GCE pages are one page each).

Everything else in DONE V40 stands, including the not-done list. Still available for review findings.
